description: This file defines the pRadar class, which provides methods to draw radar and polar charts for a charting library, including configuration of visual styles, axes, labels, and plotting data series.

classes.name: pRadar
classes.description: A class to generate radar and polar charts with customizable styling and plotting options.

methods.name: drawRadar
methods.description: Draws a radar chart based on provided data and formatting options, configuring axes, background, grid, and plotting data series.

methods.name: drawPolar
methods.description: Draws a polar chart with similar functionalities to drawRadar but configured for polar coordinate plotting.
